name: Spicy "Turkey Club" Wrap with Prosciutto & French Dressed Greens

instructions.primary_message: Peel and slice shallots crosswise into thin rings. Place in a large bowl, drizzle with vinaigrette, and set aside to soften.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ avocados
1 ½ yellow bell peppers
3 tomatoes
1 ½ (142 g) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Halve and pit avocados; cut crosswise while still in the skin, then scoop out with a spoon. Place on a large plate.
Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers into thin strips. Add to the plate with the avocado.
Slice tomatoes into thin rounds and add to the plate; set aside.
Place mayo and chili-garlic sauce in a small bowl. Stir to combine the spicy mayo.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup mayonnaise
1 tbsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Place tortillas on a flat surface and spread with a layer of spicy mayo. Divide avocado, bell pepper, tomato, turkey, and prosciutto between wraps. Roll tightly to close, then cut in half.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 large flour tortillas
680 g oven roasted turkey breast, sliced
12 slices prosciutto

instructions.primary_message: Add mixed greens to the bowl with the shallot and dressing; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide wraps and salad between plates. Enjoy!
